say:2:1620757001:1.text: Ugh... Magister Merlin, Professor Solise, thank you. I think I've come to my senses...
say:2:1620757001:1.source_cn: ……呃啊……梅林大人，娑丽丝老师，谢谢你们，我终于清醒...
say:2:1620757001:1.male: Ugh... Magister Merlin, Professor Solise, thank you. I think I've come to my senses...
say:2:1620757001:1.female: Ugh... Magister Merlin, Professor Solise, thank you. I think I've come to my senses...

say:3:1620757002:1.text: I messed up... I'm sorry. I'll never pull another prank again.
say:3:1620757002:1.source_cn: 我知道我闯祸了……对不起，我再也不会恶作剧了！

say:4:1620757003:1.text: What exactly happened in the class?
say:4:1620757003:1.source_cn: 课堂上究竟发生了什么？

say:5:1620757004:1.text: In class, I tried to sabotage the tonic as a joke and quietly cast chaos magic... but instead, the tonic turned out successful!
say:5:1620757004:1.source_cn: 课上在炼制魔药的时候，我想恶作剧让魔药炼制失败，就悄悄...

say:6:1620757005:1.text: After that, the teacher asked us to drink the vigor tonic and observe its effects. I had no choice but to go along with it... As you can see, everyone ended up like that.
say:6:1620757005:1.source_cn: 之后老师让我们喝下魔药，感受振奋魔药的作用，没办法我就...

say:7:1620757006:1.text: I swear I've learned my lesson. I'll never mess around in class again! I'll also personally apologize to all the other students.
say:7:1620757006:1.source_cn: 我保证我已经充分吸取了教训，深刻检讨了自己的错误，再也...

say:8:1620757007:1.text: ... Since you're reflecting on your mistake, I'll withhold punishment this one time.
say:8:1620757007:1.source_cn: ……看在你已经意识到错误的份上，我只能帮你这一次哦。

say:9:1620757008:1.text: Thank you so much, Professor Solise!
say:9:1620757008:1.source_cn: 太感谢您了！娑丽丝老师！
